title: Identity Token Claims (v1)
description: JWT claim set issued by identity-broker and verified locally by the gateway. Documented for contract alignment; not transported as a JSON body. Two token kinds share this shape: portal tokens (issued at login/refresh, audience-bound to the gateway, no actor) and delegated tokens (minted by the exchange endpoint for service-to-service calls, carrying an RFC 8693 'act' actor claim; see SPEC-008 / ADR-0004).

iss.description: Token issuer. Must match IDENTITY_TOKEN_ISSUER (default: luban-identity-broker).

username.description: Human-readable username. Used as X-User-ID downstream.

roles.description: Platform roles resolved from group membership.

groups.description: Raw group memberships from the identity provider.

aud.description: Intended audience(s). Portal tokens carry ["tool-gateway"]; delegated tokens carry the requested service audience. The gateway verifies this against GATEWAY_TOKEN_AUDIENCE and rejects tokens whose audience does not include it.

act.description: RFC 8693 actor claim. Present only on delegated tokens, where it identifies the acting service (e.g. {"sub": "agent-platform"}); absent on portal tokens. Logged for audit attribution but not used for policy decisions.
